title: Contractor registers: WA, OR, and CA candidate routes
hypothesis: An active contractor register can establish a named license-role candidate and a published business-contact candidate, but neither proves ownership or a direct owner mobile. State role semantics, global phone reuse, Maps contrast, independent owner evidence, and contact/compliance gates must all pass before delivery.
ownerSource: WA L&I active Individual primary principals; OR CCB RMI with sole-proprietor distinction; and CA CSLB CLEAR, unexpired Personnel titles joined to Master data. Each names a candidate role, not an owner-confirmed person.
phoneSource: WA L&I phonenumber, OR CCB phone_number, and CA CSLB Master BusinessPhone, contrasted with a matched Maps business number. All remain published business-contact candidates until exclusivity and the existing verification and owner-evidence gates pass.

workflow.label: Legal and source-state gate
workflow.detail: Choose only a WA, OR, or CA public-register route whose source conditions remain eligible; hold unavailable or restricted routes.

workflow.label: WA L&I active contractor
workflow.detail: Read active L&I rows. Only an Individual row currently persists primaryprincipalname as a named Principal candidate; LLC and Corp rows remain business-only.

workflow.label: OR CCB active contractor
workflow.detail: Read unexpired CCB rows with rmi_name and full_name. Equality marks a Sole Proprietor candidate; otherwise RMI remains a non-owner-confirmed role.

workflow.label: CA CSLB CLEAR Master and Personnel
workflow.detail: Use CLEAR, unexpired Master rows and active Personnel rows. Master BusinessPhone is joined by license number and stays business-contact evidence.

workflow.label: Hold unavailable or ineligible source
workflow.detail: Do not ingest a portal-rejected, restricted, stale, inactive, or unconfirmed-terms source route.

workflow.label: Role-candidate assessment
workflow.detail: Retain WA Individual, OR sole proprietor/RMI, and CA Sole Owner, Partner, Member, or supported officer as candidates. Do not treat a role as owner confirmation.

workflow.label: Hold unsupported ownership role
workflow.detail: Hold CA RME, unsupported RMO/officer, corporate WA business-only, and uncorroborated OR RMI cases from owner labeling.

workflow.label: Maps business contrast
workflow.detail: Match the active contractor business and preserve equal or different phone result as contrast evidence only.

workflow.label: Global phone-reuse gate
workflow.detail: Hold a phone shared across distinct businesses or people across registers, Maps, and permits. The current runtime only counts within one register source, so this gate is proposed.

workflow.label: Hold shared, absent, or business-only contact
workflow.detail: Do not infer a private number or call a shared/office line a direct owner contact.

workflow.label: Contact and owner-evidence gates
workflow.detail: Require existing mobile line-type, live, DNC, suppression/dedupe, and independent owner-evidence checks.

workflow.label: Hold failed evidence
workflow.detail: Park non-mobile, unreachable, suppressed, or unsupported-owner cases.

workflow.label: Deliver supported classification
workflow.detail: Deliver only after every contact and owner-evidence gate passes; a register candidate is never owner-confirmed by itself.

edges.label: CLEAR Master and active Personnel row

failures.risk: A principal, RMI, RMO, officer, or qualifier is labelled as owner.
failures.mitigation: Persist role provenance; hold CA RME and unsupported roles, and require independent owner evidence before an owner label.

failures.risk: CA BusinessPhone, OR phone_number, or a WA register phone is labelled a direct owner mobile.
failures.mitigation: Use it only as a business-contact candidate; require Maps contrast, global exclusivity, mobile/live/DNC/dedupe, and owner evidence.

failures.risk: A shared answering-service, franchise, or office line appears once in each source and bypasses the per-source reuse filter.
failures.mitigation: Calculate a global distinct-business/person frequency across register, Maps, and permit contacts before verification; hold numbers above threshold.

failures.risk: An inactive or stale license appears active enough to route.
failures.mitigation: Keep WA active status, OR future expiration, and CA CLEAR plus future expiration filters; require activity contrast.

failures.risk: CSLB portal rejection or unresolved terms is silently replaced by a paid or unverified source.
failures.mitigation: Park the CA source route and retain the documented portal/terms limitation until it is independently resolved.

iterations.hypothesis: A named register person and printed phone can be treated as an owner direct line.
iterations.test: Five-case fixture/code audit across WA Individual and LLC, OR sole-proprietor and RMI, and CA RME Personnel paths on 2026-09-24.
iterations.observed: The adapters preserve materially different roles. CA explicitly joins Master BusinessPhone to Personnel rows, and OR stores a business-level phone beside RMI. The audit establishes parser behavior only.
iterations.change: Use role candidates and business-contact candidates; require contrast, global exclusivity, and independent owner evidence before delivery.

iterations.hypothesis: The configured reuse filter rejects all shared contractor numbers.
iterations.test: Code audit of selectRegisterNames and lead_engine_names_reuse(p_source).
iterations.observed: The selection tests reuse_count, but the SQL frequency is scoped to p_source. It cannot see one phone reused across WA, OR, CA, Maps, or permits.
iterations.change: Propose a global distinct-business/person phone-frequency gate before bucket/verification; hold cross-source shared contacts.

measurement.result: Five synthetic adapter cases: WA Individual named Principal; WA LLC business-only; OR full_name=rmi_name Sole Proprietor; OR distinct-company RMI; CA CLEAR Personnel RME inheriting Master BusinessPhone. Code audit only, with no provider calls or phone values retained. It does not measure mobile status, reachability, DNC/TCPA, source terms, owner confirmation, or delivery.

cost.basis: Fixture/code audit only; no provider or paid verification call
cost.note: No clean delivered owner contact was measured. Historical contractor_registry brain rates remain separate and are not a per-clean cost for this workflow.

implementation.summary: WA, OR, and CA register adapters and Maps bucketing exist. State role semantics are present but cannot prove ownership. The material gap is cross-source phone reuse: the current reuse count is per register source, not global across register, Maps, and permit contacts.

nextMeasurement: After source-term authorization, run aggregate field-coverage checks for each state, then separately measure named-role candidates, globally exclusive phones, Maps buckets, mobile/live/DNC-cleared contacts, reached people, independently confirmed owners, and deliveries. Add synthetic cross-source reuse fixtures before changing the shared gate.
